summary.en: Syrian authorities arrested the suspect known as the "Butcher of Baniyas" for the 2013 coastal massacres and a separate suspect was abducted from Lebanon, while an attack on a martyrs’ cemetery in Aleppo sparked protests in Rojava. The Israeli Defense Forces permitted Lebanese and Syrian workers to enter a northern security zone to harvest olives, and a Daesh plot was foiled after a landmine blast killed a soldier. Pakistan and Syria are expanding military cooperation, and Turkey’s declared neutrality in the Ukraine war is being framed as beneficial for Syrian Kurds. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske myndigheter arresterte den mistenkte kjent som «Baniyas-slakteren» for massakrene langs kysten i 2013, og en annen mistenkt ble bortført fra Libanon, mens et angrep på en martyrkirkegård i Aleppo utløste protester i Rojava. Israels forsvarsstyrker tillot libanesiske og syriske arbeidere å gå inn i en nordlig sikkerhetssone for å høste oliven, og et IS-plan ble avverget etter at en landmineeksplosjon drepte en soldat. Pakistan og Syria utvider militært samarbeid, og Tyrkias erklærte nøytralitet i Ukraina-krigen blir fremstilt som gunstig for syriske kurdere. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
